activity_summary: You were in the afternoon's play. It was Two Gentlemen. The gown had no name on it. You did not write a part for yourself in any note. The Rose had a Toy. You did not go. You copied nothing when you came home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played the afternoon, and wrote no name.
